newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Elbit unit wins McDonnell competition.
newsitem.headline: Elbit unit wins McDonnell competition.

text.p: Vision Systems International, a company jointly owned by Elbit Ltd and Kaiser Aerospace and Electronics Corp, was selected by McDonnell Douglas Corp as the winner in a competition for helmet mounted displays.

The Israeli company Elbit said development of the display, known as the Joint Helmet Mounted Cueing System (JHMCS), will take several years and will not have a significant impact on Elbit's operating results.
JHMCS provides visual information to the wearer based on the position and orientation of the operator's head. It is intended for use on various U.S. fighter aircraft.
Elbit said in a statement it was waiting for McDonnell Douglas to issue a contract to Vision Systems before commencing the programme.
Vision Systems, based in San Jose, California, was formed to engage in the development, production and marketing of helmet mounted displays for fixed-wing aircraft.
